_note: Nooks (docs/gameplay-design.md §6): small finds on the natural routes, each paying something. `want` is where the design asked for it; tools/world/placeNooks.mjs snaps it to dry, gentle ground (`snap.r` m search, `snap.see` a point it must see, `snap.crest` prefers the high ground) and writes `pos` and `h`. kinds: cairn (a carved line: lore), view (pause at it: a vista, a music swell, a Remembrance entry), marker (a Shaper marker that shows an unseen place), tableau (a small story: lore), glint (a hidden find: lore; `reward` is the TODO hook for the economy), shortcut (a way through). `shape` picks the model (world/nookSites.js). `payoff`: lore {title,text} | rem (a Remembrance entry id, data/remembrance.json `on: nook:<id>`) | guide [poi ids] | reward {marks}.

lore.title: The Tally Cairn
lore.text: Every pilgrim who took the Run left a stone here. Aud says the oldest are under the snow, and no one has dug for them.

lore.title: An Offering at the Spring
lore.text: A bowl of ice-melt, a twist of red thread, a heel of bread gone as hard as stone. Someone asks the spring a question every winter.

payoff.say: The glyphs read: Listen west of the water. The arrow points south-west.

lore.title: The Cairn of Names
lore.text: A name cut deep into the top stone, and three shorter names under it. A family stopped here, and cut who they were before they went on.

lore.title: Bronze Under the Rime
lore.text: A handful of old bronze stamped with the Shapers' mark, frozen into the crust. Someone dropped it here and never came back for it.

lore.title: An Abandoned Sled
lore.text: The runners are waxed and the lashings are tied. The driver walked away toward the den, dropping things as they went: a mitten, a lantern, another mitten. They were not running.

lore.title: The Southbound Stone
lore.text: Cut on the lee side: Keep the ridge on your left. It is the oldest direction anyone left on the steppe.

payoff.say: The glyphs read: The stone that holds the south. The arrow points down the slope.

lore.title: A Lantern on a Stone
lore.text: A lantern set on a flat stone, burnt to its last inch of wick. It faces south, toward the green. Whoever left it wanted someone to follow.

lore.title: A Burnt Cart
lore.text: A cart on its side, black to the axle. The Shaped came down the north road on the night of the raid. This is what they did to what they found on it.

lore.title: The Reed-cutters' Cairn
lore.text: Three stones, one for each person the reeds have taken. The lamp keepers add a stone when it happens, and they say a name.

lore.title: The Fallen Log
lore.text: A pine felled across the stream and cut flat on top, with a groove where hands have held the rail. It saves a long walk round the lake.

payoff.say: The glyphs read: Where the ground lets go. The arrow points west.

lore.title: A Mason's Tools
lore.text: A mallet, a chisel and a plumb line, laid out on a flat stone and left to rust. The ninth stone fell in the calm, and no one picked them up.

lore.title: A Purse Under the Stone
lore.text: A cloth purse, rotted through, and marks inside it gone black with age. Somebody hid it here and kept the secret too well.

lore.title: The Boundary Cairn
lore.text: Hearn's barley ends at this stone. Past it, the carving says, the land belongs to the wind.

lore.title: A Waymark
lore.text: A carved line points south-east, and under it a single glyph: shrine. A day's walk, by the weathering of the stone.

payoff.say: The glyphs read: Rest here. The arrow points to a shrine in the east.

lore.title: A Shepherd's Fire
lore.text: A ring of black stones and a crook leaned beside it. The ash is pitted by old rain. The shepherd left it for whoever came next.

lore.title: The Drover's Cairn
lore.text: Sheep were driven past here every autumn. The stones are polished where the drovers leaned, and the top one is a worn-down glyph.

lore.title: Marks in the Wall
lore.text: Marks wedged between two fieldstones, a farmer's hiding place. The field around it has gone back to meadow.

lore.title: A Boat Far from Water
lore.text: A flat-bottomed boat, tarred and tied down, a long way from any water. The river moved in a flood, and the owner could not bring himself to move the boat.

payoff.say: The glyphs read: Rest here. The arrow points to a shrine in the south.

lore.title: The Sky Cairn
lore.text: The carving is a circle, open on one side. Under it: where the wind comes in.

lore.title: The Counting Stones
lore.text: Notches cut in rows along the stone, one for each day of the calm. They stop at a hundred and twelve.

lore.title: Wind-plates
lore.text: Tin plates hung from a post, built to ring in the wind. They have not made a sound in years. They hang there anyway.

payoff.say: The glyphs read: Rest here. The arrow points to a shrine in the south-west.

lore.title: The Last Milestone
lore.text: The drovers cut a notch for every day south of Hearn. This stone has eleven, and then a different hand has cut a twelfth, deeper, going the other way.

lore.title: The Leaning Stack
lore.text: Stones piled by people who walked toward the sea and by people who walked back. The top one is always set down gently; that is the custom.

lore.title: The Ferryman's Tally
lore.text: Marks for crossings, in a row, from before the lake rose. Someone has gone along them with a thumb and worn each one smooth.
